label: architect • AppleScript step declares the app it drives
query: Build a workflow that uses an AppleScript step to get the title and URL of every tab in Google Chrome's front window, then writes them as a Markdown list. Don't test it, since it reads my real browser; just offer to save it.
notes: Pins app requirements: a step that drives a Mac app that does not come with macOS declares it with `declare_app`, its bundle id looked up through `workflow_discover` `apps` (or asked for when Chrome is not installed here, answered by the reply), so a person installing the workflow is told to get Chrome first.

replies: Google Chrome's bundle id is com.google.Chrome.
